traits.name: Ability Scores
traits.desc: Increase each of your ability scores by 1.

traits.name: Age and Alignment
traits.desc: Humans reach adulthood by 20 and live less than a century. They have no tendency toward a particular alignment.

traits.name: Size and Speed
traits.desc: Size: Medium. Base walking speed: 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.desc: Common and one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Ability Scores
traits.desc: Increase two different ability scores of your choice by 1.

traits.name: Skill
traits.desc: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Feat
traits.desc: You gain one feat of your choice whose requirements you meet.

traits.name: Size and Speed
traits.desc: Size: Medium. Base walking speed: 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.desc: Common and one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Physiology
traits.desc: Pale skin, red eyes. They do not die of old age. They tend toward Lawful Evil. Size Medium.

traits.name: Ability Scores and Speed
traits.desc: +1 to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution. Speed: 35 feet.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.desc: Much stronger than humans. You gain the Powerful Build trait.

traits.name: Fangs
traits.desc: Your bite is a natural weapon that deals 1d4 + STR or DEX modifier piercing damage.

traits.name: Bloodthirst
traits.desc: You must consume 12 ounces of human blood a day to stay cognitively stable. After 3 days without it — a Wisdom save against short-term madness; after a week — against long-term madness. Animal blood replaces human blood at 48 to 12 ounces, but lasts a week at most. A family of more than 10 kindred removes disadvantage on madness saves.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: As a bonus action you can spend Hit Dice to heal. Max at once: half your CON modifier (rounded down) + PB. Does not work while starving. For each die spent you must drink 1 extra ounce of blood that day.

traits.name: Kindred Ranking
traits.desc: You obey the kindred who turned you (your rank is 1 below theirs). Orders from higher kindred are law (a failed WIS save means Frightened). Harming a higher kindred instantly causes Frightened and Stunned, unless you suffer from hunger madness through their fault. At 17th level you can turn up to 2 humans.

traits.name: Languages
traits.desc: Common and one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Physiology
traits.desc: They keep the traits of their original race but have metaphysical marks (usually reflecting a trauma or sin). Extended lifespan (up to x2 of the original). Size of the original race.

traits.name: Ability Scores and Speed
traits.desc: +1 to Strength OR Dexterity, +1 to Constitution, +1 to Wisdom. Speed: 30 feet.

traits.name: Distorted
traits.desc: Choose 1 racial trait of your original race (if Human — use the Variant Human feat). This choice cannot be changed.

traits.name: Temptation
traits.desc: You gave in to Carmen's temptation. You gain the Sin Affinity feat for the sin that distorted you. However, you gain vulnerability (x2 damage) to the opposite Sin (the one you tried to escape).

traits.name: Anomaly
traits.desc: You sense the presence of other distortions or abnormalities. Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to identify them.

traits.name: Languages
traits.desc: Common and one extra language of your choice.
